anchors.exact_quote: The concentration must be checked in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions or the test can be outsourced to a suitable laboratory. If in doubt, consult MAN Diesel & Turbo. Small quantities of lube oil in coolant can be found by visual check during regular water sampling from the expansion tank. Regular analysis of coolant is very important for safe engine operation.
